# Assay note

The viability assay compared vehicle and compound AX-17 in three biological replicates per condition.

| Condition             | Replicate 1 | Replicate 2 | Replicate 3 |
| --------------------- | ----------: | ----------: | ----------: |
| Vehicle viability (%) |          98 |         101 |          99 |
| AX-17 viability (%)   |          61 |          64 |          62 |

The plate passed the prespecified quality threshold of a Z-prime factor above 0.5; the observed Z-prime factor was 0.67. This small assay has not yet been repeated on a separate day and should not be used to claim clinical efficacy.
